name: Camp Kettleford
operator_name: Girl Scouts of the Green and White Mountains
description_short: Girl Scout day camp on 30 wooded acres by Sandy and Sebbins Ponds in Bedford for girls entering kindergarten through grade 10, with weekly themed programs by grade. Campers do crafts, target sports, paddling, swimming, campfire cooking and hikes; drop off 8:30 to 8:45, pick up 4:00 to 5:00, buses for most weeks.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 deposit, included in the session price, is not refundable.

sessions.name: Week of July 5 (grades K to 5 programs; no buses)

Week of July 12 (grades K to 5 programs)
Week of July 19 (grades K to 5 programs)
Week of July 26 (grades K to 8 programs)
Week of August 2 (grades K to 5 programs)

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; Summer 2027 sessions; registration opens December 16 at 7 a.m.; Girl Scouts entering K to grade 10, ages derived from grades (age_min = grade_min + 5, age_max = grade_max + 6); weekly programs $375 where a price shows, Summer Unlocked $750, CIT $600; buses for most sessions at extra cost; non members must buy a Girl Scout membership; campership for council members; address 26 Camp Rd, Bedford, NH 03110

warnings: Campers must be Girl Scouts; families who are not members buy a Girl Scout membership when registering (cost not on the page).
2027 prices show only for some weeks in the page text; other weeks are left blank rather than assumed to be $375.
The page says to use the camper's 2026/27 grade, but one week says 2025/26; grade range follows the 'entering K through grade 10' line.
